item.title: Missouri women’s basketball falls 71-58 to Auburn in a terror of turnovers
item.description: Errant passes and forced entry looks led to a Missouri women’s basketball 71-58 loss to the Auburn Tigers Thursday night at Mizzou Arena. Missouri turned the ball 30 times, matching a season-high. Missouri fell to 16-12 overall and 4-9 in the Southeastern Conference play following the loss compared to Auburn’s 14-13 overall and 3-10 conference...
